newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open lower.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open lower.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open flat to weaker Tuesday as bullion in London was fixed at its lowest since mid-February, with silver fixed at a two-year low.
COMEX June gold was called flat to off $0.50 after trading from $341.30 to $340.80 an ounce on ACCESS. Early bullion was quoted at $339.05/35.
COMEX July silver was called to unchanged. In London, silver fixed at $4.6425, the lowest since March 27, 1995, amid follow-through selling to Monday's losses.
